#!/bin/sh
# gamedash-managed HumanitZ server — generated by provision().
# This server's own files: <ROOT>/installs/humanitz/gamedash-servers/test
. <ROOT>/secrets.conf
python3 - "<ROOT>/installs/humanitz/HumanitZServer/GameServerSettings.ini" "$GAME_SERVER_PASSWORD" "$GAME_ADMIN_PASSWORD" <<'SYNC'
import re, sys
p, join, admin = sys.argv[1:4]
t = open(p, encoding="utf-8", newline="").read()     # keep its line endings
bom = "\ufeff" if t.startswith("\ufeff") else ""
t = t[len(bom):]
for key, val in (
    ('Password', join),
    ('AdminPass', admin),
    ('RCONPass', admin),
):
    line = '%s="%s"' % (key, val)
    pattern = r'(?m)^' + re.escape(key + '=') + r'[^\r\n]*'
    if re.search(pattern, t):
        t = re.sub(pattern, lambda m: line, t)
    else:
        pass   # not in the file: left out
open(p, "w", encoding="utf-8", newline="").write(bom + t)
SYNC
cd "<ROOT>/installs/humanitz/" || exit 1
exec ./HumanitZServer/Binaries/Linux/HumanitZServer-Linux-Shipping HumanitZServer -log -port=7790 -queryport=27180 -steamservername="Test World"
